Test builds a Henderson tabular A for the 96-animal pedigree by hand (no package builder), fits native Beta(logit) y ~ x + animal(1 + x | id, pedigree) with sd(id, coef = '(Intercept)') ~ z0 and sd(id, coef = 'x') ~ z1, and compares -logLik with an exact base-R Laplace oracle (two start points, analytic score and Hessian checked against finite differences at an off-mode probe, tol 1e-4) that integrates the unobserved ancestors; A-input and Ainv-input fits match the pedigree fit (1e-4). The linked row (animal numeric slope: intercept plus independent slope fields, pedigree) is exercised by the q2 fit with distinct SD formulas per coefficient. The test has no perturbation checks, so sensitivity was demonstrated in a scratch run on Totoro with the test's oracle function (no files edited): baseline nll difference 2e-8; swapped selector coefficient sets shift the oracle by 96.5; sign-flipped z0 by 65.7; reversed z1 by 25.9; A*2 by 9.2. Rerun 32/0/0 skips; manifest (70 files) has one mismatch, R/julia-bridge.R at HEAD (NB2 spatial slope only; not used by this native Beta fit). Does NOT establish: calibration or coverage; Julia parity; a pedigree with inbreeding (founders only here, so every diagonal of A is 1); a correlated intercept-slope block; the sensitivity checks live outside the test; any non-Beta family.
